title: Python ML: Grid Search
description: The majority of machine learning models contain parameters that can be adjusted to vary how the model learns. After finding the best model, we can optimize it using Grid Search. This method exhaustively searches through a manually specified subset of the hyperparameter space of a learning algorithm.
example:
// Grid Search with Scikit-learn
from sklearn import datasets
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.model_selection import GridSearchCV

iris = datasets.load_iris()
X, y = iris.data, iris.target

logit = LogisticRegression(max_iter = 10000)

# Define the grid of parameters
C = [0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1, 1.25, 1.5]
param_grid = [ {'C': C} ]

clf = GridSearchCV(logit, param_grid = param_grid, cv = 3)
best_clf = clf.fit(X, y)

print(best_clf.best_estimator_.get_params()['C'])

challenges.title: Optimization Tool
challenges.exercise: Print 'GridSearchCV' to confirm you know the tool used for hyperparameter optimization.
